name: Subby's Plushies & Essentials
notes: Changed the Heartkeeper glow to behave as a true native BC layer, closer to how the halo glow works.
The glow layer is now inserted at the front of the lantern's BC layer stack instead of being appended at the end.
The native glow layer priority is now 25 so it sits behind the lantern and stays behind hands more naturally.
Reduced the native glow footprint to make it visibly smaller while keeping your calibrated default offset of X 40 / Y 15.
